public.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
public.description: Cities are numbered zero through n-1. Each directed flight is [from,to,positivePrice]; no duplicate directed edges. Return the lowest source-to-destination cost using at most k intermediate cities, or -1 if impossible. Staying at the source costs zero. n is 1 to 50, k is 0 to n, prices at most 10000, and there are at most 500 flights.
hints: Relax flights in rounds using a copy of previous costs.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

javascript.signature: cheapestFlightsWithinKStops(n: number, flights: number[][], source: number, destination: number, k: number): number

typescript.signature: cheapestFlightsWithinKStops(n: number, flights: number[][], source: number, destination: number, k: number): number

explanation: After round r, costs represent paths using at most r edges. Reading only previous-round costs enforces the stop limit. O((k+1) times flights) time and O(n) space.
